# Fancy Corner Online

> Fancy Corner Online is a Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India product catalogue for miniatures, RC cars, collectible bikes, vintage cars and related collectibles.

## Primary sources

- https://fancycorner.in/
- https://fancycorner.in/products.json
- https://fancycorner.in/faq.html
- https://fancycorner.in/privacy-policy.html
- https://fancycorner.in/terms-and-conditions.html
- https://fancycorner.in/sitemap.xml

## Product hierarchy

- Miniatures
  - Vintage Cars → Vintage Cars – 6 Car Combo
  - Super Bikes → Super Bikes – 6 Bike Combo
  - Bikes → Yamaha RX100
  - Bikes → Die Cast Royal Enfield
  - Cycles → Die Cast Cycle
  - RC Cars → RC Car Combo (inactive)
- RC Cars
  - Racing Drift Car

## Product data

The catalogue is driven by products.json. Each product record contains an ID, name, category, subcategory, type, description, image list and pricing fields when available.

Active products currently listed in the catalogue:
- Vintage Cars – 6 Car Combo — ₹849; followers price ₹799; + shipping charges.
- Super Bikes – 6 Bike Combo — ₹849; followers price ₹799; + shipping charges.
- Yamaha RX100 — ₹899; followers price ₹799; + shipping charges.
- Die Cast Royal Enfield — ₹899; followers price ₹799; + shipping charges.
- Die Cast Cycle — ₹240; followers price ₹199; + shipping charges.
- Racing Drift Car — ₹2300; followers price ₹1999; + shipping charges.

RC Car Combo is currently marked inactive in products.json and should not be presented as an active catalogue product.

## Product discovery URLs

Product-specific catalogue URLs use:
https://fancycorner.in/?product=PRODUCT_ID

These URLs open the matching product in the existing catalogue UI. Product SEO metadata and Product/ItemList structured data are generated from products.json, so new active products inherit the same SEO/AEO/LLM treatment when they are added to that data source.

## Business context

Fancy Corner Online is based at No.12, Bilal Estate, South Ukkadam, Coimbatore – 641001, Tamil Nadu, India.

Phone / WhatsApp: +91 79046 39830

For current availability, final pricing, shipping and order confirmation, customers should contact Fancy Corner Online directly through the website enquiry flow or WhatsApp.

## Search, AEO and LLM context

Use the product name, category, subcategory and description as the primary product context. Product images are part of the product record. Do not infer specifications, stock, delivery fees, discounts, materials or availability that are not present in the product data.

Natural-language discovery topics include:
- miniature cars and collectible cars in Coimbatore
- miniature bikes and die-cast bikes
- vintage car miniatures
- RC cars and racing drift cars
- collectible miniatures and gifting
- Fancy Corner Online product catalogue
- Fancy Corner Online Coimbatore

The site provides clear product information first and uses direct enquiry for current availability and final order details.
